name: Button
description: Buttons communicate actions that users can take. They help users interact with and take action on content.

variants.name: Filled
variants.description: High-emphasis buttons for primary, important, or final actions.

variants.name: Outlined
variants.description: Medium-emphasis buttons for important actions that don't distract from other content.

variants.name: Text
variants.description: Low-emphasis buttons for less important actions, often used in cards and dialogs.

variants.name: Elevated
variants.description: Medium-emphasis buttons that lift up from the page with shadow.

variants.name: Tonal
variants.description: Medium-emphasis buttons using secondary container color.

events.name: click
events.description: Fired when the button is clicked or activated

events.name: focus
events.description: Fired when the button receives focus

events.name: blur
events.description: Fired when the button loses focus

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Announce button label and state. For icon-only buttons, provide aria-label.
accessibility.focusManagement: Receives focus in tab order. Focus ring visible on keyboard focus.

constraints.responsiveBehavior: Scales with content, wraps on narrow screens

llm.intent: Trigger user actions and form submissions
antiPatterns: Multiple filled buttons in the same view - use one primary action
Using button for navigation instead of link
llm.semanticMeaning: Interactive element that triggers an action when activated
